name: carousel
docs: `ScrollView(.horizontal)` + `.scrollTargetLayout()` + `.scrollTargetBehavior(.paging)`; `containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal)` sizes pages. Alt: `TabView` + `.tabViewStyle(.page)`. System owns paging, indicators, Reduce-Motion; no wrapper. Card MUST fill frame or stalls.
accessibility: Paging: native; VoiceOver page-scroll, three-finger gesture.
Label each page; combined card SHOULD read as one element.
